sentences.zh: 他们很受欢迎。

sentences.en: And suddenly, almost overnight, with a flick of a disciplinary committee chairman's pen, they become the villains.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，几乎在一夜之间，随着纪律委员会主席笔尖的一挥，他们就成了反派。

sentences.en: And it looks like FIFA is putting its thumb on the scale for the United States.
sentences.zh: 看起来国际足联在为美国队暗箱操作。

sentences.en: And now everything is suddenly being questioned.
sentences.zh: 现在一切都突然受到了质疑。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Setting aside the questions surrounding the Trump administration's involvement in all this,
sentences.zh: 撇开围绕特朗普政府介入此事的质疑不谈，

sentences.en: it also strikes me that this episode centers on this other aspect of the tournament that I think was a low for a lot of people,
sentences.zh: 我也觉得这件事的核心是锦标赛的另一个方面，我认为这对很多人来说是一个低谷，

sentences.en: which is the contentiousness of the video reviews on the field and the ubiquitousness of them.
sentences.zh: 那就是场上视频回放的争议性和无处不在。

sentences.en: Just walk me through that.
sentences.zh: 请给我详细讲讲。

sentences.en: Video assistant refereeing has been around since the 2018 World Cup in Russia.
sentences.zh: 视频助理裁判技术自2018年俄罗斯世界杯以来就一直存在。

sentences.en: And the point of it was to improve accuracy and to make sure there are no kind of miscarriages of justice on the field.
sentences.zh: 其目的是提高准确性，并确保场上不会出现任何司法不公。

sentences.en: However, people are arguing more and more.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们争论得越来越多。

sentences.en: People are angrier more and more as more of this technology is being used.
sentences.zh: 随着这项技术的广泛使用，人们变得越来越愤怒。

sentences.en: So I guess you have to be careful what you ask for.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你必须小心你所要求的。

sentences.en: And then the use of this technology led to some heartbreaking reversals.
sentences.zh: 而这项技术的使用导致了一些令人心碎的判罚逆转。

sentences.en: I think most notably, you have this moment in a game between Egypt and Argentina where Egypt, if the goal had stood,
sentences.zh: 我认为最著名的是埃及和阿根廷比赛中的那一刻，如果那个进球有效，

sentences.en: a sweeping move across the field would have been one of the goals of the tournament.
sentences.zh: 那次横跨球场的精彩进攻本可以成为本届锦标赛的最佳进球之一。

sentences.en: And Q, massive celebrations, the emotional uplift in the stadium, suddenly all of that is cut short because we are using technology to such an extent that we are at risk,
sentences.zh: Q，当时欢呼声震天，体育场内情绪高涨，但突然这一切都被打断了，因为我们过度使用技术，以至于我们面临风险，

sentences.en: many people would say, of killing the naturalness of the game, the joy, the pure moments that it can create.
sentences.zh: 许多人会说，这扼杀了比赛的自然性、乐趣以及它所能创造的纯粹时刻。

sentences.en: And that, that was one of them.
sentences.zh: 而那，就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Overall, Tarek, despite those dramas, it seems fair to say that this tournament has been a massive success, right?
sentences.zh: 总的来说，塔雷克，尽管有这些戏剧性的场面，但说这届锦标赛取得了巨大成功似乎是公平的，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's the most watched in history.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是历史上观看人数最多的一届。

sentences.en: In the U.S., which is not a big soccer country, the U.S.-Belgium game was one of the most watched sporting events of the year thus far.
sentences.zh: 在美国，虽然不是足球大国，但美国对阵比利时的比赛是今年迄今为止观看人数最多的体育赛事之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, it hit all the key metrics of audience, of drama, of excellence on the field.
sentences.zh: 是的，它在观众人数、戏剧性和场上表现方面都达到了关键指标。

sentences.en: And this is despite those exorbitant ticket prices pricing out millions of fans from around the world.
sentences.zh: 尽管高昂的票价让全球数百万球迷望而却步，但情况依然如此。

sentences.en: And we're going to break more records in the final.
sentences.zh: 而且我们将在决赛中打破更多纪录。

sentences.en: Argentina against Spain in a World Cup final.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷对阵西班牙的世界杯决赛。

sentences.en: This is going to be a game for the ages.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场载入史册的比赛。

sentences.en: All right, we're going to take a quick break.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we get back, we are going to talk about those two teaMs.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将讨论这两支球队。

sentences.en: We'll start with Spain, how they got here, and how they could win it all.
sentences.zh: 我们将从西班牙队开始，谈谈他们是如何走到这一步的，以及他们如何赢得最终的胜利。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Tarek, this may seem counterintuitive, but I think that any conversation about the identity of the Spanish team has to begin with France.
sentences.zh: 塔雷克，这看起来可能有些反直觉，但我认为任何关于西班牙队身份的讨论都必须从法国队开始。

sentences.en: At the beginning of this World Cup, France looked like a juggernaut, an almost untouchable behemoth of a squad that basically included two full rosters of all-stars,
sentences.zh: 在本届世界杯开始时，法国队看起来像是一个不可阻挡的巨头，一个几乎不可触碰的庞然大物，基本上拥有两套全明星阵容，

sentences.en: as you told us.
sentences.zh: 正如你告诉我们的那样。

sentences.en: They coasted to the semifinal on the backs of these mega-goal scorers, Mbappe, Dembele, Olisse.
sentences.zh: 他们依靠姆巴佩、登贝莱、奥利塞这些超级射手轻松进入了半决赛。

sentences.en: And then they ran into the brick wall of Spain, which shut them out in the semifinal and surprised a lot of people, I think, with this 2-0 victory.
sentences.zh: 然后他们撞上了西班牙这堵墙，我认为西班牙在半决赛中以2-0的胜利零封了他们，这让很多人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: So how did that happen?
sentences.zh: 那么这是怎么发生的呢？

sentences.en: It happened because it was a victory about team and not star, about process and not brilliance in a way.
sentences.zh: 因为它是一场关于团队而非个人的胜利，在某种程度上是关于过程而非天赋的胜利。

sentences.en: This is a style that has been put in place in the feet and in the minds of these young Spanish players from as early as they could probably kick a ball,
sentences.zh: 这是一种在这些年轻西班牙球员很小的时候，甚至可能在他们刚学会踢球时，就已经植入他们脚下和脑海中的风格，

sentences.en: as early as they could walk for some of these guys.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的一些人来说，甚至在他们刚学会走路时就开始了。

sentences.en: And you see that they are able to dominate possession in such a way that they almost keep it away from the other team long enough for them to almost have their brains fried.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他们能够以一种方式控制控球权，以至于他们几乎让对方长时间拿不到球，直到对方大脑几乎短路。

sentences.en: And I think that's what happened to France.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是法国队发生的情况。

sentences.en: Okay, you said this style of play had been put into the minds of these players from a very young age.
sentences.zh: 好的，你说这种比赛风格在这些球员很小的时候就已经植入他们的脑海中了。

sentences.en: Explain that to me.
sentences.zh: 给我解释一下。

sentences.en: How does that work?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: What are we talking about?
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论什么？

sentences.en: This is a process from the Spanish Soccer Federation that runs through schools, that runs through academies for a very young age, that everyone plays this way of playing,
sentences.zh: 这是西班牙足协的一套流程，贯穿于学校和青训学院，从很小的时候开始，每个人都以这种方式踢球，

sentences.en: which is ball possession first, this kind of hypnotic passing system.
sentences.zh: 那就是控球优先，这种催眠般的传球体系。

sentences.en: You just kind of boom, boom, boom, the ball being passed from player to player, keeping the opposition away and getting your objective that way.
sentences.zh: 你只是砰、砰、砰，球在球员之间传递，让对手远离，并以此达到你的目标。

sentences.en: There was a famous soccer manager, Sir Alex Ferguson.
sentences.zh: 有一位著名的足球教练，亚历克斯·弗格森爵士。

sentences.en: His team, Manchester United, played in the Champions League final against Barcelona, the birthplace of this modern style of play the Spanish are showing.
sentences.zh: 他的球队曼联在欧冠决赛中对阵巴塞罗那，那是西班牙人所展示的这种现代比赛风格的发源地。

sentences.en: And he said after his team lost, once you get on that carousel, it's hard to get off, i.e. his team were being led a merry dance.
sentences.zh: 他在球队输球后说，一旦你上了那辆旋转木马，就很难下来，也就是说他的球队被对方耍得团团转。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They've wowed the world with this.
sentences.zh: 他们用这一套让世界惊叹。

sentences.en: What I'm talking about is when they won the European Championship in 2008.
sentences.zh: 我指的是他们在2008年赢得欧洲杯的时候。

sentences.en: Then their first World Cup in 2010.
sentences.zh: 然后是2010年的第一座世界杯。

sentences.en: And then the European Championship again in 2012.
sentences.zh: 接着是2012年再次赢得欧洲杯。

sentences.en: They were the supreme team, the dominant team of world football about a generation ago.
sentences.zh: 大约一代人以前，他们是世界足坛的至尊球队，统治级的球队。

sentences.en: Using this style.
sentences.zh: 使用的就是这种风格。

sentences.en: Yeah, and then they hit a lull because it ended up with them just passing the ball around, the other teams defending deep,
sentences.zh: 是的，然后他们陷入了低谷，因为这最终导致他们只是在传球，而对方球队防守很深，

sentences.en: and kind of nothing happening because they couldn't actually find a way to make all those passes, those metronomic passes, turn into capital, into goals.
sentences.zh: 什么也没发生，因为他们无法真正找到一种方法将所有那些传球，那些节拍器般的传球，转化为资本，转化为进球。

sentences.en: A little too much patience.
sentences.zh: 有点太有耐心了。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, so they had to develop because the thing with soccer is once you show yourself, you show a new style, all the other coaches are going to be working to repel the style.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，所以他们必须发展，因为足球的特点是，一旦你展示了自己，展示了一种新风格，所有其他教练都会努力去抵制这种风格。

sentences.en: And eventually, defending deep, letting them have possession in areas which aren't dangerous was seen as the way to do it, and it worked.
sentences.zh: 最终，防守深位，让他们在不危险的区域控球被视为应对之道，而且奏效了。

sentences.en: They got figured out.
sentences.zh: 他们被看穿了。

sentences.en: Yeah, they got figured out.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们被看穿了。

sentences.en: And here now we have this coach, Luis de la Fuente, who's no big coach, no big name, no famous Champions League winner, no big club pedigree.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了这位教练，路易斯·德拉富恩特，他不是什么大牌教练，没有大名气，不是著名的欧冠冠军，没有大俱乐部的背景。

sentences.en: But he's come through the Spanish system, teaching these boys when they were adolescents, under 18, under 19, 21, and now here he is leading them with the national team.
sentences.zh: 但他从西班牙体系中成长起来，在这些男孩还是青少年时，U18、U19、U21阶段就教导他们，现在他带领着国家队。

sentences.en: But what he's also done, they changed Spain.
sentences.zh: 但他还做了什么，他们改变了西班牙。

sentences.en: Yes, we're going to do all of this passing, but we're also going to add pace and power down the sides.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们要进行所有的传球，但我们也要在边路增加速度和力量。

sentences.en: And where that comes from primarily is this superstar, the teenager, Lamin Yamal.
sentences.zh: 而这主要来自于这位超级巨星，少年拉明·亚马尔。

sentences.en: The 19-year-old just remind us why he's so special.
sentences.zh: 这位19岁的球员，提醒我们他为什么如此特别。

sentences.en: Up against Lamin Yamal, who picks his pocket.
sentences.zh: 面对拉明·亚马尔，他被抢断了。

sentences.en: Oh, wonderful from Yamal.
sentences.zh: 哦，亚马尔表现太棒了。

sentences.en: This guy is playing soccer at the highest level, as if he was having a kick around with his friends in the park.
sentences.zh: 这家伙在最高水平上踢球，就像和朋友在公园里踢着玩一样。

sentences.en: He is playing against some of the world's best players and making it look easy.
sentences.zh: 他正在与世界上一些最好的球员对阵，而且看起来毫不费力。

sentences.en: Back post, there's career World Cup goal.
sentences.zh: 后点，那是职业生涯的世界杯进球。

sentences.en: He's thrilling to watch.
sentences.zh: 看他踢球真是令人兴奋。

sentences.en: You just don't know what he's going to do next as well.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道他接下来会做什么。

sentences.en: He's unpredictable, and he seems to be able to deliver under pressure.
sentences.zh: 他不可预测，而且似乎总能在压力下有所表现。

sentences.en: Yamal, Omo, Yamal, Ruiz is still wide.
sentences.zh: 亚马尔，奥莫，亚马尔，鲁伊斯还在边路。

sentences.en: That was beautiful football.
sentences.zh: 那真是美丽的足球。

sentences.en: And now he gets the stage to do that at a World Cup final, where the pressure is going to be at its higheSt.
sentences.zh: 现在他有机会在世界杯决赛中展示这一点，那里的压力将是最大的。

sentences.en: And am I right that he hasn't had a terrific World Cup up until this point?
sentences.zh: 我没说错吧，他到目前为止在世界杯上的表现并不出色？

sentences.en: He hasn't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有。

sentences.en: He hasn't to his standards.
sentences.zh: 以他的标准来看确实没有。

sentences.en: But again, that also speaks to what Spain is.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，这也说明了西班牙是什么。

sentences.en: Spain is not a national team that you have a star and you play for him.
sentences.zh: 西班牙不是那种拥有一个球星并围绕他踢球的国家队。

sentences.en: Spain is process.
sentences.zh: 西班牙是过程。

sentences.en: Spain is process and repetition, repetition and process.
sentences.zh: 西班牙是过程和重复，重复和过程。

sentences.en: And in there is Lamin Yamal.
sentences.zh: 而拉明·亚马尔就在其中。

sentences.en: He has to do the work as well.
sentences.zh: 他也必须付出努力。

sentences.en: And Spain have largely managed to ease their way through this competition, go through the gears, find a level they needed to against the opposition they faced.
sentences.zh: 西班牙在很大程度上设法轻松度过了这次比赛，换挡提速，针对所面对的对手找到了所需的水平。

sentences.en: They did that against France.
sentences.zh: 他们在对阵法国队时就是这样做的。

sentences.en: I do think if the moment arises and the ball is at this young man's feet, we might be in for something magical.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，如果时机成熟，球在这个年轻人脚下，我们可能会看到奇迹发生。

sentences.en: Okay, so Spain has its system of suffocating keep away, a potential X factor in this young, unpredictable phenom.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以西班牙有其令人窒息的控球体系，还有这位年轻、不可预测的天才作为潜在的X因素。

sentences.en: The only thing standing in their way is...
sentences.zh: 唯一阻碍他们前进的是……

sentences.en: Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to take another break.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要再休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we come back, we will talk about the legend of Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们将讨论利昂内尔·梅西的传奇。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Tariq, the time has come to discuss this man, Messi.
sentences.zh: 塔雷克，现在是讨论这个人，梅西的时候了。

sentences.en: The man many consider to be the greatest soccer player of all time.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为他是史上最伟大的足球运动员。

sentences.en: Before we get into who he is, let's just establish why we're going to talk about him.
sentences.zh: 在我们深入了解他是谁之前，让我们先确定为什么要谈论他。

sentences.en: If Spain is a system with a young star attached to it, Argentina is kind of a star with a system designed entirely around him.
sentences.zh: 如果说西班牙是一个附带年轻球星的体系，那么阿根廷就是一种围绕他量身定制体系的球星。

sentences.en: Do you agree?
sentences.zh: 你同意吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this guy, Lionel Messi, he's almost 40.
sentences.zh: 是的，这家伙，利昂内尔·梅西，快40岁了。

sentences.en: And yet, he is the fulcrum of this team.
sentences.zh: 然而，他仍然是这支球队的支柱。

sentences.en: He has been one of the standout players of this tournament and certainly the engine of this team.
sentences.zh: 他是本届锦标赛表现最出色的球员之一，当然也是这支球队的引擎。

sentences.en: They play for him.
sentences.zh: 他们为他而战。

sentences.en: Everything is designed in this Argentina model to get Lionel Messi on the ball and for him to deliver.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷模式的一切设计都是为了让利昂内尔·梅西拿球，并让他完成任务。

sentences.en: And he has done that throughout this tournament.
sentences.zh: 他在整个锦标赛中都做到了这一点。

sentences.en: Let's not forget, he started this tournament with question marks about, oh, is this guy too old?
sentences.zh: 别忘了，他开始这届锦标赛时还带着质疑，哦，这家伙是不是太老了？

sentences.en: Is it one tournament too many, including from myself?
sentences.zh: 是不是多余的一届锦标赛了？包括我自己也这么想。

sentences.en: Yes, I remember that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: And what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他做了什么？

sentences.en: He scores three goals in the first game of the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 他在世界杯的第一场比赛中就进了三个球。

sentences.en: And there's your answer.
sentences.zh: 这就是你的答案。

sentences.en: And Argentina have had a perilous, perilous journey through this competition.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷在这场比赛中经历了一段极其危险的旅程。

sentences.en: But Lionel Messi has always been there.
sentences.zh: 但利昂内尔·梅西一直都在那里。

sentences.en: Okay, let's run it back.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下。

sentences.en: Tariq, just give me the basics of who Messi is.
sentences.zh: 塔雷克，简单介绍一下梅西是谁。

sentences.en: A little bio here.
sentences.zh: 来点个人简介。

sentences.en: Yeah, Lionel Messi is from Rosario in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 是的，利昂内尔·梅西来自阿根廷的罗萨里奥。

sentences.en: And he shows this great soccer talent.
sentences.zh: 他展现了极高的足球天赋。

sentences.en: But he has this growth problem.
sentences.zh: 但他有生长发育问题。

sentences.en: And he needs this medication that his family can't afford.
sentences.zh: 他需要一种他的家庭负担不起的药物。

sentences.en: And he ends up moving to Spain.
sentences.zh: 最终他搬到了西班牙。

sentences.en: Not just moving to Spain.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是搬到西班牙。

sentences.en: He ends up moving to Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 他最终搬到了巴塞罗那。

sentences.en: This finishing school, the best there is for global soccer.
sentences.zh: 这所精修学校，是全球足球最好的地方。

sentences.en: And the chapters Lionel Messi has written in the history of global football, I don't think could ever be written again.
sentences.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西在世界足球史上书写的篇章，我认为永远无法再被书写。

sentences.en: What he has done is just phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 他所做的一切简直是现象级的。

sentences.en: Not just the numbers, but the artistry, the way he plays.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是数据，还有那种艺术感，他踢球的方式。

sentences.en: It is honestly an absolute privilege to have been around at the time of Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 说实话，能生活在利昂内尔·梅西的时代，绝对是一种荣幸。

sentences.en: And for those millions of Argentinians, he brings them so much joy.
sentences.zh: 对于那数百万阿根廷人来说，他带给了他们太多的快乐。

sentences.en: The devotion to this guy is everywhere, including on his team.
sentences.zh: 对这个人的崇拜无处不在，包括在他的球队里。

sentences.en: I've read that the Spanish coach, Pep Guardiola, Messi's former coach,
sentences.zh: 我读到过，西班牙教练佩普·瓜迪奥拉，也就是梅西的前教练，

sentences.en: has told people not to write about Messi or even try to describe him because the only way to understand him was to watch him.
sentences.zh: 曾告诉人们不要去写关于梅西的文章，甚至不要试图去描述他，因为了解他的唯一方式就是观看他的比赛。

sentences.en: But can you, Tariq, just try to describe what makes him so special?
sentences.zh: 但是，塔里克，你能试着描述一下是什么让他如此特别吗？

sentences.en: He just plays like no one else we've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 他踢球的方式是我们从未见过的。

sentences.en: It is like someone has him at the end of a video controller and is just sort of slaloming through the opponents.
sentences.zh: 就像有人在用游戏手柄操控他，让他穿梭在对手之间。

sentences.en: And then if he needs to ping one into the top corner, he'll do that.
sentences.zh: 如果他需要把球射进死角，他就能做到。

sentences.en: And if he needs to just sort of chip one into the path of his teammate, he gets exactly the right flight and the right control.
sentences.zh: 如果他需要把球挑传到队友的跑动路线上，他能精准地控制球的飞行轨迹和力度。

sentences.en: As if the ball is controlled by some sort of mechanism.
sentences.zh: 就好像球是被某种机械装置控制着一样。

sentences.en: It's like he has another sense that the rest of his opponents can't see.
sentences.zh: 他仿佛拥有某种其他对手无法察觉的感知力。

sentences.en: And he magically appears in the right places.
sentences.zh: 他总能神奇地出现在正确的位置。

sentences.en: And to just see him, this tiny, ordinary-looking fellow, has magic in his feet.
sentences.zh: 看着他，这个身材矮小、外表平凡的家伙，他的双脚却蕴含着魔力。

sentences.en: It is such a sight to see.
sentences.zh: 那真是一场视觉盛宴。

sentences.en: And the thing is, when you see him in the arena itself, there is an intake of breath.
sentences.zh: 关键是，当你亲临现场看他比赛时，你会不由得屏住呼吸。

sentences.en: You feel it.
sentences.zh: 你能感受到那种氛围。

sentences.en: You feel it around the stadium and energy, electricity from when the ball is at his feet.
sentences.zh: 你能感受到整个球场弥漫着那种能量，当球在他脚下时，那种电流般的触感。

sentences.en: Something is going to happen because Lionel Messi's on the ball.
sentences.zh: 因为利昂内尔·梅西拿球了，总会有事情发生。

sentences.en: And also, you've seen Argentina come through this tournament.
sentences.zh: 而且，你也看到了阿根廷队在这次锦标赛中的表现。

sentences.en: And it's clearly not just being him.
sentences.zh: 显然，这不仅仅是因为他一个人。

sentences.en: But because they have him in the team, it does give them hope that whatever the circumstance the team finds itself in,
sentences.zh: 但因为队里有他，这确实给了他们希望，无论球队处于什么境地，

sentences.en: they're going to be okay because they've got Messi in the team.
sentences.zh: 他们都会没事的，因为他们有梅西在队中。

sentences.en: Can you just describe that, that relationship that these group of men on this team have to this star?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下这群队友与这位球星之间的那种关系吗？

sentences.en: They are so devoted to this guy.
sentences.zh: 他们对他非常忠诚。

sentences.en: It's almost like they have a figure from another world, an alien he's being called, in their ranks.
sentences.zh: 就好像他们的队伍里有一位来自另一个世界的人物，人们称他为“外星人”。

sentences.en: And they do everything they can to protect him.
sentences.zh: 他们竭尽全力去保护他。

sentences.en: And there was a moment in this semi-final victory over England.
sentences.zh: 在这次半决赛战胜英格兰队的比赛中，有这样一个瞬间。

sentences.en: It was the first half.
sentences.zh: 那是上半场。

sentences.en: Lionel Messi is taken out by an England midfielder.
sentences.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西被一名英格兰中场球员放倒了。

sentences.en: And suddenly, from all corners of the field, this like posse of bodyguards, if you want, arrive to protect him, to defend his honor.
sentences.zh: 突然间，从球场的各个角落，一群保镖似的人冲了过来，保护他，捍卫他的尊严。

sentences.en: You can't do that to Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 你不能那样对待利昂内尔·梅西。

sentences.en: And in that moment, you get the sense of how important he is to them and just how much they revere him.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，你就能感觉到他对他们有多重要，以及他们有多么敬重他。

sentences.en: Tarek, before the tournament started, you told me that this team would probably not be in the final at all.
sentences.zh: 塔里克，在锦标赛开始前，你曾告诉我这支球队可能根本进不了决赛。

sentences.en: I hate to do this to you, but why were you wrong?
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉这么说，但你为什么会错呢？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I was even more emphatic than that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时说得比那还要肯定。

sentences.en: What I said was, lo siento, amigos.
sentences.zh: 我说的是，抱歉了，朋友们。

sentences.en: Argentina will lose against the first good team they play.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷队在遇到第一支强队时就会输球。

sentences.en: And there is a massive amount of egg on my face right now.
sentences.zh: 现在我的脸被打得啪啪响。

sentences.en: And my Argentinian friends are letting me know about that.
sentences.zh: 我的阿根廷朋友们正以此来取笑我。

sentences.en: That said, Argentina have had a fairly troubled run.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，阿根廷队这一路走来相当坎坷。

sentences.en: And they really labored to these victories.
sentences.zh: 他们确实是费尽周折才赢下这些比赛的。

sentences.en: But there is something about this team, beyond Lionel Messi as well.
sentences.zh: 但除了利昂内尔·梅西之外，这支球队确实有些特别之处。

sentences.en: There is a suffering that they are able to endure to get through the other side.
sentences.zh: 他们有一种能够忍受苦难并最终走出困境的能力。

sentences.en: Now, I was looking at this and thinking, Spain, in a way, is this friction-free, process, almost boring team that gets into the final without a bead of sweat on their forehead.
sentences.zh: 我观察到这一点，心想，西班牙队在某种程度上是一支没有摩擦、按部就班、甚至有些乏味的球队，他们不费吹灰之力就进入了决赛。

sentences.en: A well-oiled machine.
sentences.zh: 一台运转良好的机器。

sentences.en: Argentina, there's so much friction.
sentences.zh: 而阿根廷队，充满了摩擦。

sentences.en: It almost feels like the stadium is on fire every time they've played.
sentences.zh: 每次他们比赛时，感觉球场就像着了火一样。

sentences.en: The fans are crying.
sentences.zh: 球迷们在哭泣。

sentences.en: The players are crying.
sentences.zh: 球员们在哭泣。

sentences.en: The emotional outpouring required to get through each of these games is just wild.
sentences.zh: 为了挺过每一场比赛所需要的情感宣泄简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And yet, they've been able to do it.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们还是做到了。

sentences.en: And again, against England, they were minutes from elimination and then stepped up again.
sentences.zh: 再次面对英格兰队时，他们离被淘汰只有几分钟之遥，然后又挺身而出。

sentences.en: Against Switzerland, Egypt should be eliminated.
sentences.zh: 对阵瑞士队时，埃及队本该被淘汰的。

sentences.en: Cape Verde being taken to the wire.
sentences.zh: 佛得角队也被逼到了绝境。

sentences.en: You see it again and again.
sentences.zh: 你一次又一次地看到这种情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They are the comeback kings of this tournament, indisputably led by Messi, who never looks like he thinks he's going to lose.
sentences.zh: 他们是本届锦标赛的逆转之王，毫无疑问是由梅西领衔的，他看起来从不认为自己会输。

sentences.en: And it sort of seems as though nothing can stop him.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎没有什么能阻止他。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to find that out because in Spain, they're kind of diametrically opposed to Argentina for all the passion, all the suffering,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们拭目以待，因为在西班牙队，他们与阿根廷队截然相反，尽管有激情、有苦难，

sentences.en: all the reliance on this genius to bail them out.
sentences.zh: 以及对这位天才拯救球队的依赖。

sentences.en: Spain is a team that never seems to be panicked, believes in its process, is mechanical almost in its play and just sort of steamrolls through its opponents.
sentences.zh: 西班牙队是一支从不惊慌的球队，他们坚信自己的流程，踢球几乎像机械一样，横扫对手。

sentences.en: It's system over passion.
sentences.zh: 这是系统高于激情。

sentences.en: This is the rivalry.
sentences.zh: 这就是竞争。

sentences.en: This is the final we're going to see.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将要看到的决赛。

sentences.en: What's going to be, what's going to win here?
sentences.zh: 什么会胜出呢？

sentences.en: Is it going to be that studious years of development of Spanish football that's taken them to another final?
sentences.zh: 是西班牙足球多年来刻苦钻研的成果将他们带入又一场决赛吗？

sentences.en: Or is it going to be this Argentine passion, the will to suffer, the will to go through the fire?
sentences.zh: 还是这种阿根廷式的激情，那种受苦的意志，那种穿越火线的意志？

sentences.en: And with this guy, with this genius, the belief that whatever they face on the field, it's OK.
sentences.zh: 有了这个家伙，有了这个天才，他们相信无论在场上遇到什么，都没关系。

sentences.en: Lionel Messi will get us out of the hole.
sentences.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西会把我们从困境中拉出来。

sentences.en: Tarek, will you be there?
sentences.zh: 塔里克，你会去现场吗？

sentences.en: Are you going to be at the final?
sentences.zh: 你会去决赛现场吗？

sentences.en: I will be.
sentences.zh: 我会去的。

sentences.en: And I'm very, very excited and interested to see how this turns out.
sentences.zh: 我非常非常兴奋，也很想看看结果如何。

sentences.en: What a month it has been.
sentences.zh: 这一个月真是太难忘了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: What are you going to do when this is all over?
sentences.zh: 这一切结束后你打算做什么？

sentences.en: What am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 我打算做什么？

sentences.en: Well, what I'm going to do is do some laundry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我打算洗洗衣服。

sentences.en: A month on the road is not kind to your clothes.
sentences.zh: 在外奔波一个月，衣服都快没法穿了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, for now, we are looking forward to this game.
sentences.zh: 那么，现在我们都在期待这场比赛。

sentences.en: I'll be watching from my couch, but I feel like in a way we will all be watching with you.
sentences.zh: 我会在沙发上观看，但我感觉在某种程度上，我们都会和你一起观看。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being our guide to such a special World Cup.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你担任我们这届特殊世界杯的向导。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Caitlin O'Keefe, Carlos Prieto and Claire Tennisgetter.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由凯特琳·奥基夫、卡洛斯·普列托和克莱尔·坦尼斯格特制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klinkenberg.
sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·克林肯伯格编辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Marion Lozano, Dan Powell, Alicia Baetup, and Diane Wong.
sentences.zh: 包含马里昂·洛萨诺、丹·鲍威尔、艾丽西亚·贝图普和黛安·王创作的音乐。

sentences.en: This episode was engineered by Daniel Ramirez.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由丹尼尔·拉米雷斯担任录音师。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittrowef.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方订阅收听。
